text:
Type: shaggy high-pile area rug
Use: adding softness and warmth underfoot, under a sofa, bed or coffee table; living room, bedroom
Style: contemporary, retro, modern
Materials: thick long shag pile yarn
Colors: warm medium brown, solid
Shape: rectangular, deep plush shag, solid color, soft fluffy edges, large and cushiony
Feel: cozy, warm, soft, inviting
Goes with: beige, cream and caramel tones, dark wood, leather; cozy contemporary or retro living rooms

product.name: DUM
product.description: The dense, thick pile dampens sound and provides a soft surface to walk on.
